title: My future
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y8 lesson 28 (Pupil PDF worksheet: my future)
intro: Lesson 28: Future jobs: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَكُونَ. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

model.title: Say: in the future I want to be a doctor.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَكُونَ طَبِيبًا

head: Not this
This
rows: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُعَلِّمًا (accusative after كَانَ)

questions.q: Say: I hope to be a teacher (girl).

My future in the portal response box: three sentences on the job you want, where you would work and one thing you would do (use أُرِيدُ / أَتَمَنَّى). Start: 'فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَكُونَ ...'
questions.a: Three correct sentences with accusative endings

questions.q: Extend: ask a partner مَاذَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَكُونَ؟
Correct: 'I want to be an engineer' (boy)
questions.a: A) أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُهَنْدِسًا. -an after أَكُونَ.

questions.q: After أَنْ أَكُونَ the job ends in ...
Think again: your job and how it helps?
